subject: Student support rota
body:
Support cover proposal

I can cover twenty minutes during Nora's planning meeting. That is the first part of the gap, not the entire support hour. The remaining cover needs someone else's name before the rota is published.

Separate technical problems, coursework questions and Finance requests. Lena can help with a login, but she shouldn't be booked as an essay reviewer because the form calls both things help.

Students should be able to give a brief private heading. Lian's question doesn't need to become a public group discussion before an appointment can be made. Keep the details with the relevant support person. David
title: Student support rota
